fusions.name: Mounted Rush
fusions.desc: Rides you to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes it for 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoof-Kicked Dust
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of dust 2.5 tiles long that deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Flank
fusions.desc: Presses your cold blood to the warmth of your mount: your health regeneration rises 60% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Ride Mending
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
